branches.conclusion: The current GSEM doctoral admissions inventory explicitly lists Economics, Econometrics, Management, Statistics, Finance and Information Systems. None is titled Operations, Operations Research, Operations Management, Management Science or Industrial Engineering. Operations Management on the Institute of Management page is a research area, not shown as an admissions field.

The Faculty of Science current doctoral mentions include Mathematics, Statistics and Informatics. The 2025-26 regulations for each name only those mentions, with no formally named Operations/OR/OM/MS/IE doctoral field. Mathematicians' possible research topics are not assumed to be formal doctoral titles.

The Faculty of Science central doctoral mention list does not name Industrial Engineering, but institution-wide technical school/doctoral unit inventory beyond this faculty has not been fully reconciled.
